Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to
on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If
applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the
agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s office during normal business
hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make
inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be
made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the
Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours
prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however,
to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a
presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council must
fill out a green speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The card permits
the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific
agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City
Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of
items shown on the agenda.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
  March 23, 2010

A regular meeting of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates was called to order
this day at 7:00 p.m. in the City Council Chambers of City Hall by Mayor Perkins.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Bird, Rea, Goodhart, Mayor Pro Tem Humphrey,
  Mayor Perkins

ABSENT:  None

ALSO PRESENT:  City Manager Hoefgen, City Attorney Pannone, Assistant City
  Manager Smith, Police Chief Dreiling, Public Works Director Rigg,
  City Treasurer Sherwood, Administrative Analyst Davis,
  Minutes Secretary Monson

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC – none

OPENING REMARKS FROM MAYOR PERKINS

Mayor Ellen Perkins said serving as Mayor is an honor and a privilege. She had the pleasure of
representing the City at various events throughout the year. She thanked the Commission and
Committee members for their service. She focused on three areas during her term as Mayor – financial
stability, disaster preparedness and communications. She acknowledged the commitment and
professionalism of the City staff. She thanked her colleagues on the Council whom each bring great
ideas and seek out what is best for the City and the residents. She thanked her family for their support.

CEREMONIAL MATTERS

Mayor Pro Tem Humphrey presented Mayor Perkins with a gavel plaque commemorating her year as
Mayor. She also presented Mayor Perkins with a gift from the Council. Mayor Pro Tem Humphrey
commented that Mayor Perkins approaches every issue with careful and thoughtful research and
deliberation, acting with poise and grace.

Councilmember Rea said it was a privilege to serve with Mayor Perkins. He said Mayor Perkins is
unfailingly polite, gracious and courteous. He said she has reached out to the public, the other Council
members and the staff. He thought her quarterly Mayor’s Forums were a successful innovation.

Councilmember Goodhart said he and Mayor Perkins had served on the School Board together where
he had an appreciation for Mayor Perkins’ skills and capabilities which she has continued as a City
Council member. He felt the Mayor’s Forums were helpful and beneficial to the residents. He
CITY COUNCIL  1
MARCH 23, 2010
 appreciates her emphasis on disaster preparedness. He announced that Mayor Perkins has served as the
2nd Chair on the South Bay City Council of Governments (SBCCOG) and will now move to the 1st
Chair. He believes her work on the SBCCOG will be very beneficial to PVE.

Councilmember Bird thanked Mayor Perkins for her leadership during his first year on the Council.
He said Mayor Perkins served with style, grace and kindness. He thanked her for all she has done for
him, his family and the community.

Mayor Perkins nominated Rosemary Humphrey as Mayor. The nomination was seconded by
Councilmember Rea and unanimously approved.

Councilmember Bird nominated Councilmember John Rea for Mayor Pro Tempore. The nomination
was seconded by Councilmember Goodhart and unanimously approved.

Mayor Humphrey commented that at one point in time Ellen Perkins and Jim Goodhart were
technically her bosses as they were both on the School Board. Mayor Humphrey recognized the
former Mayors in attendance in the audience. She said that she took her first oath of office to the City
Council 21 years ago. She introduced her family and thanked them for their support. She said the PVE
City Council members want to hear from residents and she invited residents to call the staff or the
Council at any time. She believes the Council is a five person team working together on issues of
importance to the community.

CONSENT AGENDA

It was moved by Councilmember Goodhart, seconded by Councilmember Bird and unanimously
approved that the following Consent Agenda items be approved:

•  MINUTES OF CITY COUNCIL MEETING OF MARCH 9, 2010

•  SPECIAL EVENT APPLICATION BY AIDS/LIFECYCLE TO HOLD ITS “DAY ON THE
  RIDE TRAINING EXPERIENCE” ON SATURDAY, APRIL 17, 2010

•  SPECIAL EVENT APPLICATION FOR THE LUNADA BAY HOMEOWNERS’
  ASSOCIATION TO HOLD AN EARTH DAY EVENT ON SUNDAY, APRIL 18, 2010, ON
  THE PASEO LUNADO GREEN BETWEEN PALOS VERDES DRIVE WEST AND VIA
  RIVERA AND TO POST SIGNS PROMOTING THE EVENT

•  PARKLANDS COMMITTEE MEETING ITEM OF MARCH 8, 2010
  PC-310-10; Application to top 2 Silver Dollar Eucalyptus trees located in the parklands adjacent
  to 1417 Via Castilla by 5-feet
  Applicant: Richie-Bray, Inc.
  Action: Denied

CITY COUNCIL  2
MARCH 23, 2010
 DEMANDS

It was moved by Councilmember Goodhart and seconded by Councilmember Bird that the
demands, as approved by a majority of the City Council, totaling $226,862.48 be allowed and it was
unanimously approved.

It was moved by Councilmember Goodhart and seconded by Councilmember Bird that the
demands, as approved by a majority of the City Council No. 516944V, 517156 to 517222 totaling
$846,503.79 be allowed and it was unanimously approved.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business before Council the meeting was adjourned at 7:20 p.m. to
Wednesday, March 31 st, 2010 at 1:00 p.m. in the City Council Chambers for purposes of a Budget
Workshop.

  RESPECTFULLY SUBMITTED,

  MICHÉLE D. MONSON, MINUTES SECRETARY

APPROVED:

ELLEN PERKINS, MAYOR
